coordinateNotes: Positions/directions are glTF (right-handed). Unity glTF importers mirror X on import, so positionUnity/directionUnity negate X. Pivot = bottom-center of footprint at road surface (Y=0).

conventions.collision: Each piece has one invisible box mesh named <PieceName>_COL (material "Collision"); strip its renderer on import and add a BoxCollider from its bounds.
conventions.sockets: Socket position = center of the connecting edge at road-surface height; direction = outward edge normal. Pieces connect when socket types match, positions coincide and directions are opposite.
conventions.rightHandTraffic: Stop lines, ramps and arrows assume right-hand traffic in Unity space.

deviations: Road_2Lane_NoSidewalk uses a 0.5 m shoulder (not 1 m) so 7 m asphalt fits the 8 m tile; Road_4Lane_NoSidewalk keeps the 1 m shoulder.

Cross-section widths are padded with grass verge to grid multiples: 2-lane+sidewalk = 16 m, 4-lane+sidewalk = 24 m. 2-lane roads center on a tile center, 16 m-wide profiles on a tile boundary; transitions shift the centerline by 4 m to stay on grid.
Curve radius = smallest value giving ≥4 m inner asphalt radius while keeping sockets on grid (e.g. 2-lane+sidewalk: centerline 8 m, asphalt 4.5–11.5 m ≈ requested 4/11 m).
45° curves share the 90° footprint and end on a diagonal socket; pair two for a 90° turn.
Added materials: Dirt (dirt road), Water (puddles), Collision (COL meshes). Stone uses Concrete; bus shelter has no glass.
Highway has no sidewalk variant or at-grade intersections (use ramps/overpass). Y-junction and roundabout are provided for the 2-lane street.
At-grade bridges keep the deck at Y=0 over a gap; overpasses sit at Y=6 and connect via 32 m ramp approaches.
